changes.title: UIMSD opens without blocking the rendering thread on history preparation
changes.text: Recorder flushing and warm-history freshness scans run on the loader. Exact validated saved layouts, catalog and Home statistics are reused after the flush when still current; changed history follows full validation. A ready Home is built before the first scene draw.

changes.title: Back and table pages avoid repeated work
changes.text: UIMSD preserves exact query results for its four nearest Back destinations, verifies dataset identity before reuse and changes pages without running the same query again. Android Back applies a pending menu transition before drawing the outgoing screen again. APD Settings implementation is unchanged.

changes.title: Exact results and background ownership have regression coverage
changes.text: New tests check background-only flushing, post-flush invalidation, exact warm catalog and Home transfer, stale-load rejection, bounded Back results, pagination and scene-request single consumption. Complete core run40712827076 passed2110 methods in409 suites with zero failure, error or skip.

changes.title: Actual menu Back timing and completed-animation footer touches are required
changes.text: Android Back fixtures explicitly enter the title. A physical-key timing check covers nine menu routes with a250ms responsiveness budget and no fixed sleep inside the measurement. UIMSD timing is included in the standard native inventory. Footer retaps wait for the restore animation to re-enable Hide UI, retaining the outside-icon hit and hide assertions. Display profiles use only the exact-source producer, never an older ancestral APK.
